unity_vehicle_model.wheel_inertia_derivation: Unity WheelCollider::AddWheelToExistingVehicle sets PhysX mMOI=0.5*mMass*(effectiveRadius)^2; active F1TENTH prefab has mass 0.109 kg, radius 0.059 m, unit transform scale
unity_vehicle_model.sprung_mass_derivation: Unity WheelCollider::UpdateVehicleSpringCMOffsetsAndMasses passes transformed wheel-centre offsets, Rigidbody COM and mass to PxVehicleComputeSprungMasses(gravityDirection=1)
unity_vehicle_model.tire_force_model: Unity VehicleComputeTireForce from matching UnityPlayer symbol-bearing build; curve response and combined-slip ellipse are direct native-code translations

tire_load_filter.source: PhysX 4.1 PxVehicleTireLoadFilterData default; rest load is wheel mass plus sprung mass

unity_vehicle_model.load_model: PhysX 4.1 source spring/damper force for a flat horizontal contact plane; uses source ray direction, jounce, gravity projection, and contact-normal projection
unity_vehicle_model.model_boundary: Historical CasADi differential/algebraic tire+wheel+spring model; not native PhysX scene solver, collision impulses, wheel-contact recursion or exact 1 ms map. Mandatory native replay follows.
unity_vehicle_model.tire_slip_coordinates: PhysX 4.1 applied-torque branch (Unity NoDrive has motor or brake torque at each optimizer node): longSlip=(R*omega-vx)/(max(abs(vx),abs(R*omega))+0.1m); lateralSlip=atan(vy/(abs(vx)+1m)). The remaining approximation is the planar contact-point/tire-axis velocity reconstruction; low-speed sticky constraints are not modeled.
